name: Kettlebell Romanian Deadlift
description: Holding a kettlebell in both hands, push your hips back with soft knees until you feel the backs of your legs stretch, then stand tall.

source.title: Romanian Deadlift (ACE Exercise Library)
source.note: The kettlebell version, described in our own words. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Feet hip-width apart, the bell hanging in both hands in front of your thighs.
cues: Hips back, not down; knees soft.
Back flat, the bell close to your legs.

prescription.note: Move slowly: about 2 seconds to lift or push and 2 seconds to lower. Start with a light bell.

keyframes.name: Stand tall
keyframes.cue: Weights in front of your thighs.

keyframes.name: Hinge
keyframes.cue: Push your hips back and lower the weights down your legs.
